_comment: Registry of outside models. Slugs and prices live ONLY here. Verify on openrouter.ai before editing, and update lastTested when you do. costPer1M is USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

openai/gpt-6-astra.strengths: Flagship reasoning and coding. Good for long multi-step analysis, reading a lot of code at once, and second opinions on architecture.
openai/gpt-6-astra.notes: Default outside model. Priced and verified from the OpenRouter model list on 2026-09-22.

openai/gpt-6-astra-pro.strengths: Same model in pro reasoning mode. Only for the hardest problems where a normal answer has already fallen short.
openai/gpt-6-astra-pro.notes: Same per-token price as the base model, but it thinks far longer, so a real answer costs several times more. Reasoning tokens bill as output.
